study type: Single-arm, open-label, phase I clinical trial
exposure: Intrathecal injection of allogeneic human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes (HUC-MSCs-exosomes)
outcome: Neurological assessment (ASIA scale, pinprick, light touch scores)
cohort: Nine patients with complete subacute spinal cord injury (SCI) were recruited for the study.
finding: Intrathecal injection of allogeneic HUC-MSCs-exosomes was safe and well tolerated, leading to significant improvements in ASIA pinprick and light touch scores, SCIM III total score, and NBD score at 12 months post-injection.
